stories.title: Senco Gold shares gain 6% on strong Q2 business update; revenue rises 31% YoY

en.title: Senco Gold shares gain 6% on strong Q2 business update; revenue rises 31% YoY
en.summary: Senco Gold's stock price increased following a robust Q2FY27 performance, with revenue climbing 31% year-over-year. The jewellery retailer attributed growth to festive demand, steady consumption, and increased customer interest in lightweight jewellery despite volatile gold prices.

en.summary: Jubilant FoodWorks achieved 11.9% revenue growth in Q2FY27 and expanded its store network by 108 locations, yet share prices declined initially before recovering slightly. Domino's India contributed 4.1% like-for-like growth to the company's consolidated performance.

en.title: Adani Enterprises shares fall 4% despite getting CARE Ratings upgrade to AA; stable

en.title: Ola Electric shares drop 4% as EV maker plans Rs 1,000 crore rights issue
